label: Whatever is MOTION_1 moved in some respect is MOTION_3 held in some respect
paraphrase: OPEN analyst sense bridge from MOTION_3 to MOTION_1, attribution deferred: if f is being moved (the First Way's MovedIn, MOTION_1, definition a7904c82) in some respect, then f is MOTION_3 held (definition ea1904bc) in some respect: f is in act in that respect and something other than f presently actualizes it there. It does not require the holding respect to be the respect of the motion. Strongest support: the First Way's own premise that whatever is moved is moved by another (4a952b96), together with the simultaneity of a per se mover and what it moves, gives a present actualizer of the moved thing in the act of its being moved. Substantive objection, recorded: accounts on which a motion, once begun, continues without any present mover (inertial uniform motion, and the extrinsic inertialist account of continued being recorded at 40a97664) deny a present actualizer; on those accounts the bridge fails for anything moved only by a past mover.
